description: This Java class defines a JWT authentication filter for a Spring Boot application. It intercepts HTTP requests to validate JWT tokens, extract the username, load user details, and set the security context with an authenticated user.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationFilter
classes.description: A filter that processes incoming HTTP requests to validate JWT tokens, authenticate users, and set the security context accordingly.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Main logic to extract, validate, and set authentication based on JWT token in the request.

methods.name: resolveToken
methods.description: Extracts the JWT token from the Authorization header if present.
